input.free_text_description: The system operates in the banking, e-commerce domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include account, customer, product.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to manage my account settings, so that my preferences and personal data stay under my control.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage customer operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage transfer operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
